full_prompt_en: A square manga-influenced anime close-up shows a stern bald hero filling the frame against a diagonal gray backdrop. The head is cropped at the top and right, so only one complete eye and a sliver of the second remain visible. His wide white eye at left and tiny dark pupil look directly outward beneath a severe angled brow. A deep shadow runs from the upper forehead down across the left half of the face, while the right half is a flatter warm gray-brown plane. Bright white accents strike the bridge of the nose, the forehead, and the lower lip. The long straight nose, compressed mouth, and strong cheek planes are defined with spare black contours and close-set hatch marks. Small beads of moisture or light flecks are visible near the cheek and brow, adding a tense surface detail without changing the calm expression. At the lower left, a dark red cloak or garment enters the frame in broad folds, providing the only saturated color. Behind the head, dense diagonal pencil-like lines sweep from upper left to lower right across a pale gray area. The viewpoint is extremely close and frontal, leaving no setting, horizon, or ground plane. Flat anime color blocks and inked contours give the face immediate clarity, while fine crosshatching roughens the shadow edge and adds pressure around the eye. Light appears to strike from the upper right and front, creating hard small highlights and leaving the opposite cheek in heavy dark shade. The overall composition is compressed and confrontational, using stark eye contact, one red accent, and slanted hatching to heighten tension.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、带漫画感的动漫极近特写呈现一名严肃的光头英雄，填满画幅，背后是斜线密布的灰色底。头部在上缘和右缘被裁去，因此只完整露出一只眼睛，第二只仅有一小部分。左侧宽大的白眼和细小深瞳在严厉斜眉下直望画外。一道深影从额头上方向下横过半边脸，另一半是较平坦的暖灰棕色平面。明亮白色重音打在鼻梁、额头和下唇。长而直的鼻子、紧闭的嘴与强硬颊面由简练黑轮廓和紧密排线界定。面颊和眉旁可见细小汗珠或亮点，为紧张的表面添细节，却不改变冷静神情。左下方，深红披风或衣物以宽阔褶皱进入画幅，成为唯一饱和颜色。头后，密集的铅笔般斜线从左上向右下扫过浅灰区域。视点极贴近且正面，没有场所、地平线或地面。平坦动漫色块与墨色轮廓让面孔立即清楚，细交叉排线则粗化阴影边缘，在眼周增加压力。光似乎从右上前方照来，形成坚硬的小高光，使反侧脸颊留在沉重深影中。整体构图压缩而直面观者，以严厉对视、一处红色重音和斜向排线加剧紧张。
style_prompt_en: The manga-influenced anime treatment uses broad flat value planes, stark black contours, and closely spaced diagonal hatching. One narrow saturated red region punctuates a mostly warm gray, off-white, and charcoal palette. Hard selective highlights and large shadow blocks create strong graphic depth without gradual blending. Fine line density increases near the focal contrast, while simpler areas remain almost blank, making the eye travel quickly to the high-value center. A close crop removes ordinary spatial cues and lets cropped forms extend beyond the frame. Background strokes run in one diagonal direction, pressing visual energy against a more stable central silhouette. Slight grain and tiny light flecks keep the flat surfaces from feeling sterile. The overall effect is severe and immediate, with economical color and disciplined line pressure generating tension.
style_prompt_zh: 这种带漫画感的动漫处理使用宽阔平坦明度平面、鲜明黑轮廓和紧密斜排线。一处狭窄饱和红色穿透以暖灰、灰白和炭黑为主的色板。坚硬选择性高光与大块阴影无需渐进融合便建立强图形纵深。细线密度在焦点对比附近增加，较简单的区域几乎留白，使视线迅速抵达高明度中心。贴近裁切移除普通空间线索，让形体继续伸出画幅。背景笔迹沿同一斜向运行，把视觉能量压向更稳定的中央剪影。轻微颗粒和细小亮点让平坦表面不至于无菌。整体效果严厉而直接，以节制色彩和有纪律的线条压力制造张力。
theme_en: A stern bald hero in an extreme anime close-up
theme_zh: 严肃光头英雄的极近动漫特写
name: One-Punch Man
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
